[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-31[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Task freshness: a rolling review lease for Ready tasks[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every visible, non-recurring Ready task can carry a human-confirmed[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]\[fresh:: YYYY-MM-DD]. A task that was never confirmed (every new [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]capture) or was confirmed longer ago than its refresh interval is [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]due for review. The interval is 7 days by default and can be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]overridden per task, per note, and in config. Bryan works through [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the due tasks each morning in their source notes with ]s / [s and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Alt+F / Alt+Shift+F, and the status bar always shows how many tasks[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]are due and how many he refreshed today. Every supported keymap and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bob capture edit stamps the tasks it rewrites; task creation and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]automation never do.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]10[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202609/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]task_freshness_review.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/task_freshness_review.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-31[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-31/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Freshness contract, placement helper, evaluator, and config in[bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]bob-cli[/bold #D7AFFF]

    [#D7D7AF]conformance vectors), the Rust placement helper stamp_fresh / [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]set_refresh, the pure evaluator, and the freshness: config block, with a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]test per vector and parse-invariance tests for both Rust task parsers.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob freshness list and seed[/bold #D7AFFF]                                   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]and a guarded, idempotent, staggered cutover seed (bob freshness seed) [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that aborts on any parse change, plus help, README, and CLI tests.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]and tests updated.[/#D7D7AF]
